cases.name: CLAUDE.md TEST flow complete
cases.execute: const fs = await import("fs"); const md = fs.readFileSync($root+"/CLAUDE.md","utf-8"); return md.includes("diagnose") && md.includes("bug_report") && md.includes("trace 快照") && md.includes("自动 bug_report") && md.includes("自动标 fixed")

cases.name: CLAUDE.md reviewer not responsible for test_auto
cases.execute: const fs = await import('fs'); const path = await import('path'); const p = path.join($root, '.claude', 'agents', 'test-case-reviewer.md'); const prompt = fs.readFileSync(p,'utf-8'); return prompt.includes('不要运行 test_auto') && prompt.includes('不修改代码')

cases.name: non-TEST sections preserved
cases.execute: const fs = await import("fs"); const md = fs.readFileSync($root+"/CLAUDE.md","utf-8"); return md.includes("PLAN → DEV → TEST_CASE") && md.includes("三方制衡") && md.includes("Fixture 写法") && md.includes("行为准则")

cases.name: hint text matches CLAUDE.md TEST section
cases.execute: const fs = await import("fs"); const md = fs.readFileSync($root+"/CLAUDE.md","utf-8"); const storySrc = fs.readFileSync($root+"/packages/main/src/mcp/handlers/story.ts","utf-8"); return md.includes("V8 profiler trace") && storySrc.includes("V8 profiler trace")

cases.name: TEST stage described only once in detail
cases.execute: const fs = await import("fs"); const md = fs.readFileSync($root+"/CLAUDE.md","utf-8"); const detailMatches = (md.match(/### TEST 阶段详细流程/g) || []).length; return detailMatches === 1

cases.name: reviewer section preserves pass/fail rules
cases.execute: const fs = await import("fs"); const md = fs.readFileSync($root+"/CLAUDE.md","utf-8"); return md.includes("判定权始终在 reviewer") && md.includes("不改代码也不改 case")

cases.name: CLAUDE.md includes diagnose and arch_trace commands
cases.execute: const fs = await import("fs"); const md = fs.readFileSync($root+"/CLAUDE.md","utf-8"); return md.includes("koala diagnose") && md.includes("koala arch_trace")
